# Crosswalk coverage at CodeMeta 3.1

<!-- Generated by `codemeta-drift hub coverage examples/mapping-3.1.json --codemeta <checkout>`; edit the curated rows, not this file. -->

How CodeMeta's 3.1 crosswalks map 17 CodeMeta terms in 31 formats, read from the reviewed [mapping export](mapping-export.md). PEP 621 has no CodeMeta crosswalk, so each of its paths is added here. This page shows the pinned tag; the [web page](https://simonvanlierde.com/codemeta-drift/) also checks CodeMeta's main branch each week.

| Mark | Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ✓ | as-is | CodeMeta's crosswalk cell is the path, used unchanged |
| ✎ | corrected | the crosswalk cell is wrong, ambiguous or prose; a curated row replaces it |
| + | added | the format has the field but the crosswalk has no cell for it; a curated row adds it |
| – | no field | the format has no field for this term |

## Curated cells

### cff-1.2.0

- `author.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `person.orcid / identifiers / doi` → `authors[].orcid`. The cell lists person.orcid / identifiers / doi; a person's ORCID is orcid.
- `contributor` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell for contributors; CFF 1.2.0 has no contributor list, only authors.
- `contributor.givenName` (no field): crosswalk cell `person.given-names` → no path. No cell for contributors; CFF 1.2.0 has no contributor list, only authors.
- `contributor.familyName` (no field): crosswalk cell `person.family-names` → no path. No cell for contributors; CFF 1.2.0 has no contributor list, only authors.
- `contributor.@id` (no field): crosswalk cell `person.orcid / identifiers / doi` → no path. No cell for contributors; CFF 1.2.0 has no contributor list, only authors.
- `license` (corrected): crosswalk cell `license / license-url` → `license`. The cell lists license / license-url; license-url holds a licence URL, not an SPDX id.
- `identifier` (corrected): crosswalk cell `identifiers / person.orcid / doi` → `doi | identifiers[type=doi].value`. The cell lists identifiers / person.orcid / doi; the software DOI is doi, or the doi entry of identifiers.
- `swhid` (corrected): crosswalk cell `identifiers / person.orcid / doi` → `identifiers[type=swh].value`. The cell lists identifiers / person.orcid / doi; a SWHID is the swh entry of identifiers.

### zenodo

- `author.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `creators[].name`. No cell; Zenodo keeps one name string per creator, written 'Family, Given'.
- `author.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `creators[].name`. No cell; Zenodo keeps one name string per creator, written 'Family, Given'.
- `author.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `ORCID` → `creators[].orcid`. The cell says ORCID; the .zenodo.json key is orcid.
- `contributor` (added): no crosswalk cell → `contributors[]`. No cell; .zenodo.json lists contributors under contributors, each with a name, a type and an optional orcid.
- `contributor.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `contributors[].name`. No cell; Zenodo keeps one name string per contributor, written 'Family, Given'.
- `contributor.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `contributors[].name`. No cell; Zenodo keeps one name string per contributor, written 'Family, Given'.
- `contributor.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `ORCID` → `contributors[].orcid`. The cell says ORCID; the .zenodo.json key is orcid.
- `identifier` (corrected): crosswalk cell `id` → `doi`. The cell says id, the Zenodo record id; the DOI field is doi.
- `swhid` (corrected): crosswalk cell `id` → `related_identifiers[scheme=swh].identifier`. The cell says id, the Zenodo record id; a SWHID is the identifier of the related_identifiers entry with scheme swh.
- `codeRepository` (corrected): crosswalk cell `related_identifiers.isSupplementTo` → `related_identifiers[relation=isSupplementTo].identifier`. The cell says related_identifiers.isSupplementTo, a relation, not a key; the URL is the identifier of the entry with that relation.

### pep621

- `name` (added): no crosswalk cell → `project.name`. No PEP 621 crosswalk upstream.
- `version` (added): no crosswalk cell → `project.version`. No PEP 621 crosswalk upstream.
- `author` (added): no crosswalk cell → `project.authors[]`. No PEP 621 crosswalk upstream.
- `author.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `project.authors[].name`. No PEP 621 crosswalk upstream; an author has one name string.

### datacite

- `name` (corrected): crosswalk cell `title` → `titles[].title`. The cell says title, the XML element; in the REST JSON titles is a list of objects with a title key.

The cell says nameIdentifier, the XML element; in the REST JSON identifiers sit in nameIdentifiers, each with a nameIdentifierScheme, and the ORCID is the one whose scheme is ORCID.
- `contributor` (corrected): crosswalk cell `contributor` → `contributors[]`. The cell says contributor, the XML element; the REST JSON key is contributors, a list of objects that each carry a contributorType.
- `contributor.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `nameIdentifier` → `contributors[].nameIdentifiers[nameIdentifierScheme=ORCID].nameIdentifier`. The cell says nameIdentifier, the XML element; in the REST JSON identifiers sit in nameIdentifiers, each with a nameIdentifierScheme, and the ORCID is the one whose scheme is ORCID.
- `license` (corrected): crosswalk cell `rights` → `rightsList[].rightsUri`. The cell says rights, the free-text statement; bolognese's CodeMeta writer and commonmeta take the licence from rightsUri.
- `identifier` (corrected): crosswalk cell `identifier` → `doi`. The cell says identifier, the XML element; the REST JSON holds the DOI in doi (bare, such as 10.5281/zenodo.7635478), and identifiers is the list of alternate identifiers.
- `swhid` (corrected): crosswalk cell `identifier` → `relatedIdentifiers[relatedIdentifierType=SWHID].relatedIdentifier`. The cell says identifier, the element that holds the DOI; DataCite 4.7 added SWHID as a relatedIdentifierType, so a SWHID is a related identifier.
- `codeRepository` (added): no crosswalk cell → `relatedIdentifiers[relationType=IsSupplementTo].relatedIdentifier | url`. No cell; DataCite has no repository property. Zenodo records the repository as a related identifier with relationType IsSupplementTo; bolognese's CodeMeta writer uses url, which holds the repository for DOIs registered from codemeta.json.
- `description` (corrected): crosswalk cell `description` → `descriptions[descriptionType=Abstract].description`. The cell says description, the XML element; in the REST JSON descriptions is a list, and the summary is the one with descriptionType Abstract. bolognese's CodeMeta writer takes the first description, which is the Abstract in most records.
- `keywords` (corrected): crosswalk cell `subject` → `subjects[].subject`. The cell says subject, the XML element; in the REST JSON subjects is a list of objects with a subject key.
- `datePublished` (corrected): crosswalk cell `publicationYear` → `dates[dateType=Issued].date | publicationYear`. The cell says publicationYear, a bare year; bolognese's writers give datePublished as the Issued date and use publicationYear only when there is none.

- `author.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `packages[].originator | packages[].supplier`. No cell; originator and supplier keep the whole name in one string, with no given and family name apart.

- `contributor.familyName` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; a package has no contributor field.

### dcat-3

- `name` (corrected): crosswalk cell `dcterms:title` → `title`. The cell says dcterms:title; the path uses its bare local name because the grammar has no ':'.
- `version` (corrected): crosswalk cell `dcat:version` → `version | versionInfo`. The cell says dcat:version, which DCAT 3 added for the version name or identifier of a resource; the path is its local name, with owl:versionInfo after it, which Zenodo's DCAT export writes.
- `author` (corrected): crosswalk cell `dcterms:creator` → `creator[]`. The cell says dcterms:creator; a dataset can have several creators, so the path is a list of its local name creator.
- `author.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `creator[].givenName`. No cell; the spec types a creator as foaf:Agent, whose person form carries foaf:givenName.
- `author.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `creator[].familyName`. No cell; the spec types a creator as foaf:Agent, whose person form carries foaf:familyName.
- `author.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `dcterms:identifier` → `creator[].@id`. The cell says dcterms:identifier, which names the identifier of a resource and not of an agent; an ORCID is the agent's own IRI, so the @id of the creator node.
- `contributor` (corrected): crosswalk cell `dcterms:contributor` → `contributor[]`. The cell says dcterms:contributor; a list of its local name, as for creator.
- `contributor.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `contributor[].givenName`. Same reasoning as author.givenName, under contributor.
- `contributor.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `contributor[].familyName`. Same reasoning as author.familyName, under contributor.
- `contributor.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `dcterms:identifier` → `contributor[].@id`. Same reasoning as author.@id, under contributor.
- `license` (corrected): crosswalk cell `dcterms:license` → `license | distribution[].license`. The cell says dcterms:license, which DCAT allows on the dataset and on each distribution; the path reads the dataset's, else a distribution's.
- `identifier` (corrected): crosswalk cell `dcterms:identifier` → `identifier`. The cell says dcterms:identifier; the path is its local name. The software DOI is one of its values.
- `swhid` (corrected): crosswalk cell `dcterms:identifier` → no path. The cell says dcterms:identifier, which holds the DOI; DCAT has no property of its own for a SWHID.
- `codeRepository` (corrected): crosswalk cell `dcat:accessURL` → no path. The cell says dcat:accessURL, a property of dcat:Distribution that usually points at a landing page or a download, not a repository.
- `description` (corrected): crosswalk cell `dcterms:description` → `description`. The cell says dcterms:description; the path is its local name.
- `keywords` (corrected): crosswalk cell `dcat:keyword` → `keyword`. The cell says dcat:keyword; the path is its local name.
- `datePublished` (corrected): crosswalk cell `dcterms:issued` → `issued`. The cell says dcterms:issued, the date of formal issuance; the path is its local name.

### doap

- `version` (corrected): crosswalk cell `revision` → `release[].revision`. The cell says revision, which belongs to doap:Version, not to the project; a project reaches a Version through doap:release, so the path is release[].revision.
- `author` (corrected): crosswalk cell `developer` → `developer[] | maintainer[]`. The cell says developer, but most DOAP files (Apache's, GNOME's) list only maintainer, so the path falls back to it.
- `author.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `developer[].name | maintainer[].name`. No cell; DOAP people are foaf:Person nodes and the name most DOAP files give is foaf:name, one string.
- `author.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `developer[].name | maintainer[].name`. No cell; DOAP people are foaf:Person nodes and the name most DOAP files give is foaf:name, one string.
- `author.@id` (added): no crosswalk cell → `developer[].@id | maintainer[].@id`. No cell; DOAP has no ORCID property, but a foaf:Person node can be named by its ORCID IRI, which JSON-LD keeps as @id.
- `contributor` (corrected): crosswalk cell `developer` → `helper[]`. The cell says developer, which is also author's path; doap:helper is DOAP's term for a project contributor, so contributors read from helper.
- `contributor.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `helper[].name`. No cell; DOAP people are foaf:Person nodes and the name most DOAP files give is foaf:name, one string.
- `contributor.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `helper[].name`. No cell; DOAP people are foaf:Person nodes and the name most DOAP files give is foaf:name, one string.
- `contributor.@id` (added): no crosswalk cell → `helper[].@id`. No cell; DOAP has no ORCID property, but a foaf:Person node can be named by its ORCID IRI, which JSON-LD keeps as @id.
- `identifier` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty and DOAP has no property for a DOI or other persistent identifier of a project.
- `swhid` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty and DOAP has no property for a SWHID or other persistent identifier.
- `codeRepository` (corrected): crosswalk cell `repository/location` → `repository[].location`. The cell says repository/location in XPath form; in the compacted JSON-LD tree the repository node's location is repository[].location (the node's type, GitRepository or SVNRepository, is @type).
- `datePublished` (added): no crosswalk cell → `release[].created`. The cell is empty; a release's date is doap:created on its doap:Version node, so the path is release[].created.

### wikidata

- `name` (added): no crosswalk cell → `labels.en.value`. The cell is empty; a Wikidata item has no name property; its name is its label, one per language under labels.
- `version` (added): no crosswalk cell → `claims.P348[].mainsnak.datavalue.value`. The cell is empty; software version identifier (P348) holds the version, one statement per release.
- `author` (corrected): crosswalk cell `P50` → `claims.P50[] | claims.P178[]`. The cell says P50, which is not a key of the entity JSON: statements sit under claims, and each statement is a list entry; software items mostly use P178 (developer) instead, so it is the fallback.
- `author.givenName` (corrected): crosswalk cell `P735` → no path. The cell says P735, but P735 sits on the person's item and holds an item of a given name; this record holds only the person's Q id.
- `author.familyName` (corrected): crosswalk cell `P734` → no path. The cell says P734, but P734 sits on the person's item and holds an item of a family name; this record holds only the person's Q id.
- `author.@id` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; the ORCID (P496) sits on the person's item, not on this one.
- `contributor` (corrected): crosswalk cell `P767` → `claims.P767[]`. The cell says P767, which is not a key of the entity JSON: statements sit under claims, and each statement is a list entry.
- `contributor.givenName` (corrected): crosswalk cell `P735` → no path. The cell says P735, but P735 sits on the person's item; this record holds only the person's Q id.
- `contributor.familyName` (corrected): crosswalk cell `P734` → no path. The cell says P734, but P734 sits on the person's item; this record holds only the person's Q id.
- `contributor.@id` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; the ORCID (P496) sits on the person's item, not on this one.
- `license` (corrected): crosswalk cell `P275` → `claims.P275[].mainsnak.datavalue.value.id`. The cell says P275, which is not a key of the entity JSON; the licence is an item, so its Q id is the value.
- `identifier` (added): no crosswalk cell → `claims.P356[].mainsnak.datavalue.value`. The cell is empty; DOI (P356) holds a DOI.
- `swhid` (added): no crosswalk cell → `claims.P6138[].mainsnak.datavalue.value`. The cell is empty; Software Hash Identifier, SWHID (P6138), holds the Software Heritage id.
- `codeRepository` (corrected): crosswalk cell `P1324` → `claims.P1324[].mainsnak.datavalue.value`. The cell says P1324, which is not a key of the entity JSON; source code repository URL is a url statement.
- `description` (added): no crosswalk cell → `descriptions.en.value`. The cell is empty; a Wikidata item has a short description per language under descriptions.
- `keywords` (corrected): crosswalk cell `P921` → `claims.P921[].mainsnak.datavalue.value.id`. The cell says P921, which is not a key of the entity JSON; main subject holds items, so the value is a Q id.
- `datePublished` (corrected): crosswalk cell `P577` → `claims.P577[].mainsnak.datavalue.value.time`. The cell says P577, which is not a key of the entity JSON; the date is the time field of a time value.

## Not reviewed

CodeMeta has 16 more crosswalks with no reviewed mapping. A mark here says only what the cell looks like, not whether it is right.

| Mark | Shape | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| • | path | the cell reads as a path, but nobody has checked that it is right |
| ¶ | prose | the cell is prose or a list, not one path |
| ○ | empty | the cell is empty: the format may have no field, or the crosswalk leaves it out |
| ? | unmatched | the crosswalk and the property table list this property a different number of times |
